scope: Root-cause analysis and immutable native requalification of the Play2Code ROT180 recorded-path failure without changing BCL/1 or the coordinate transformation

root_cause.finding: The penultimate M4 movement sample carried the final recorded directional tick but was accepted solely because its own target was inside the unchanged 0.3-block radius. The immediately following sealed hold sample was 0.301871765790311 blocks away and cannot emit directional input. With no residual movement, ROT180-A therefore stopped as recorded_path_sample_not_reached.
root_cause.qualification_boundary: The terminal sample-completion defect is causally reproduced. Historical per-tick telemetry was not retained, so the exact earlier native tick at which ROT180-A lost approximately one movement increment cannot be reconstructed.

isolated_reproduction.fixture_source: A copy of the retained ROT180-A ended save; historical evidence was not modified.
isolated_reproduction.administrative_setup: Completed and sealed before each measured run.
isolated_reproduction.complete_M4_before_fix: 5/5 succeeded under controlled initial conditions, confirming that the original intermittent trigger was not deterministic from the nominal M4 start alone.
isolated_reproduction.exact_terminal_suffix_before_fix: 0/3; every run reproduced recorded_path_sample_not_reached at exactly 0.301871765790311 blocks with zero directional pulses.
isolated_reproduction.exact_terminal_suffix_after_fix: 3/3 succeeded; every run used exactly one already-recorded right+sneak pulse.
isolated_reproduction.complete_M4_after_fix: 5/5 succeeded with both embedded placements independently observed.

correction.summary: Before accepting a directional sample immediately followed by a hold sample, both sealed targets must be inside the existing arrival radius. Otherwise the runtime may issue only the current sample's already-recorded one-tick direction under the existing three-pulse bound.

pre_measurement_control_record.event: The first ROT180-C launcher invocation stopped with a host FileNotFoundError because the private preparations output directory did not yet exist.
pre_measurement_control_record.phase: Before preparation, client launch, BCL submission or gameplay effects
pre_measurement_control_record.resolution: The missing private output directory was created; the frozen source remained byte-identical and the same run identity then began its only gameplay attempt.

repeatability.claim_boundary: This demonstrates strict repeatability for the frozen QROT02 cohort and equivalent isolated Superflat fixture, not universal reliability in arbitrary worlds.

independent_acceptance.each_success: Exact 71-block structure, zero missing/incorrect/unexpected cells, complete roof, clear entrance, accessible interior and safe player
independent_acceptance.persistent_relative_home: Exactly one first-batch S1 relative; continuation batches did not re-home

limitations: ROT180-A remains an immutable NO_GO and is not relabelled.
Direction-sensitive block-state rotation remains unqualified; the benchmark uses cobblestone.
The result qualifies the frozen H04 strategy on equivalent isolated Superflat snapshots, not arbitrary structures, terrain or another human strategy.
privacy: Raw timelines, exact private player observations, player identity, actor sessions, worlds, journals, credentials, certificates and private keys remain outside this public-safe evidence file.
